title: Canonical open pro-etale pullback evaluation and its unit
statement:
Let $X,U$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, with constant ring sheaves $\Lambda_X,\Lambda_U$ on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use the actual module inverse and direct images $j^*,j_*$ and unit $\eta_j$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with the canonical coefficient identification of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact]. Let $M$ be any sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

There are isomorphisms
$$\rho_{M,W}:(j^*M)(W\to U)\xrightarrow{\sim}M(W\to U\to X)$$
for every pro-etale object $W\to U$, natural in $M$ and in $W$, and linear under the constant-coefficient restriction identification in [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Under these isomorphisms, the component of the specified adjunction unit at every pro-etale $V\to X$ is exactly restriction:
$$\rho_{M,V\times_XU}\circ\eta_{j,M}(V)=\operatorname{res}_{V\times_XU/V}:M(V)\longrightarrow M(V\times_XU).$$
Here the codomain of $\eta_{j,M}(V)$ is $(j_*j^*M)(V)=(j^*M)(V\times_XU)$ by the direct-image formula [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and the fibre product is that of [def-pc-fibre-product]. The isomorphisms refer to the actual inverse image constructed on compatible small skeletons as in [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. No quasi-compactness or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09BN, lemma-open-immersion, via localization of the open site; canonical inverse-image evaluation and unit normalization made explicit from the construction in def-weil-proetale-inverse-image.
